players.product: data-center chillers, BASX custom air handlers & liquid-cooling packages (Redmond / Memphis)

quarterly_data.signal: AAON's consolidated backlog at December 31, 2025 was $1,828.5 million, up 110.9% from December 31, 2024; BASX-branded backlog rose 141.3%, or $762.4 million, to $1,302,145 thousand (from $539,747 thousand), and most of these orders were associated with BASX-branded data center liquid cooling solutions. The majority of the combined backlog is considered firm and expected to be delivered within 12 to 18 months; the 10-K notes data center orders carry more risk of timing shifts, cancellations and re-issuances than commercial air conditioning orders.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $1,828.5 million at December 31, 2025 (+110.9%); BASX-branded backlog $1,302,145 thousand (+141.3%, +$762.4 million)

quarterly_data.signal: AAON cites $204.9 million of capital expenditures in 2025, including the acquisition of intangible assets. 2025 capital expenditures related to infrastructure and machinery for replacement and production growth, finalizing new production space in Redmond, Oregon and Longview, Texas, additional equipment and production capacity in Parkville, Missouri, and new equipment for the Memphis, Tennessee facility. The capital expenditure program for 2026 is estimated at approximately $190.0 million.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 capex $204.9 million (including intangible assets); 2026 capex program ~$190.0 million
